name: GetAllExcelWorksheets
label: Get All Excel Worksheets
description: Retrieves all worksheet names from the provided Excel workbook instance, optionally filtered by a specific worksheet instance.

fields.name: WorkbookInstance
fields.label: Workbook Instance
fields.description: The Excel Workbook object containing the worksheets to retrieve.

fields.name: WorksheetNames
fields.label: Worksheet Names
fields.description: Returns a list of all worksheet names in the provided Excel workbook.
